description: This file defines the NodeSponsor class which functions as a model for handling sponsor nodes in a system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and validating sponsor data, as well as managing associated images.

classes.name: NodeSponsor
classes.description: Model class representing a sponsor node, providing methods for data access, validation, image handling, and persistence within the system.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a NodeSponsor instance from the database by node ID; throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current sponsor node data to the database, performing validation beforehand.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the Image instance associated with this sponsor, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the sponsor data meets required criteria, primarily ensuring the 'name' is not empty.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns an array of language-related fields for localization purposes.
